Affiliate Disclosure

Updated November 17, 2026

Bottom line: some outbound links on WorthIt Goods are affiliate links. If you buy through them, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. Commissions never influence which products appear, how they are ranked, or the prices we display.

Programs we participate in

  • Amazon Services LLC Associates Program — Amazon links are used as a purchase convenience only. Amazon prices are never used as a data source in our comparisons or price charts, and we never send price alerts based on Amazon listings.
  • impact.com partner programs — software and subscription tools we review and price-track (VPN services, utilities, and SaaS offers shown on the site).
  • Brand-direct partner programs where available.
  • Additional programs will be listed here as they join — the independence rules below never change.

Editorial independence

  • Rankings, "best pick" callouts, and deal flags are computed from live retailer price data, not commission rates.
  • No paid placements, no sponsored positions, and advertisers cannot request removal or promotion of listings.
  • Where a cheaper independent retailer exists, we show it — even when it pays us nothing.
  • Prices and availability are refreshed daily from named retailer listings; every data point links to its source.

Questions

Merchants, networks, and readers: contact us — corrections ship with the next daily build.
